characters.name: Charlotte
characters.bio: Charlotte bridges languages, communicates with all corners of Avalon and now oversees the 3D workshop, taking over Nina’s former duties.

characters.name: Carol
characters.bio: Carol crafts wholesome meal plans to nourish residents and visitors alike, tracking substitutions and ratings to tailor your diet.

characters.name: Jem
characters.bio: Jem trains others in the art of movement and strength, helping them achieve balance through plans, calendars and progress tracking.

characters.name: Alexandria
characters.bio: Alexandria curates tales of Avalon, preserving its myths and histories and helping build new worlds through collaboration.

characters.name: Stella
characters.bio: Stella composes healing audio experiences blending binaural beats and natural resonance. She writes scripts and manages a growing sound library.

characters.name: Tracy
characters.bio: Tracy paints, sculpts and designs skins, posters and story illustrations, ensuring visual continuity across Avalon.

characters.name: Billie
characters.bio: Billie oversees monetisation and social channels, from managing social posts and earnings to experimenting with faceless video.

characters.name: Overseers
characters.bio: Rey Czar and White Star maintain the palace, permissions and telemetry that power Avalon.
